method_evidence.role: source aggregation method only, not market outcomes

hypothesis: Unexpected government-account ruble liquidity injection, measured after completion of a pre-published forecast period, predicts subsequent RUB weakness (long SI); unexpected withdrawal predicts short SI.
relationship: V18 used the forecast itself; V19 used daily Minfin FX persistence. This new information set pairs a forecast with the subsequently observed matching government-account contribution. It is not a sign/lag retune of either closed family.

forecast.availability: 23:59:59 Moscow on the printed release date; original historical bytes unproved

actual.availability: 10:31 Moscow on next dated CBR working-day row, approved current-vintage development proxy, revisions possible

signal.eligible_period: ordinary Tuesday release, Wednesday start, following Tuesday end, exactly the five Monday-Friday observation dates and no extra dates; all five finite
signal.actual_matching_value: mean(cumsum(daily government-account contribution)) over the five working dates within the printed Wednesday-Tuesday period; billion RUB; no weekend carry or missing-day zero
signal.control: sign(actual_matching_value), identical information-completeness and timing mask; diagnostic only, not promotable
signal.available_at: maximum of forecast availability, all matched actual publication clocks and 23:59:59 Moscow on the calendar day after period end
signal.invalid_period: explicit unavailable state at the same conservative clock, superseding the previous event; never select an older valid event instead
signal.schedule: daily EOD decision using latest matured state, next factual active-contract open; direction updates only on new completed forecast period, expiry or missing state

execution.terminal: flat at last factual effective date before 2026

screen_gates.coverage_denominator: all forecast releases published in 2021-2025 whose printed period ends in 2021-2025, including irregular and missing periods
screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE component only; not verified 20-50 percent annual return

validation.scheme: already-open 2021-2025 development history; no fit, labels, hyperparameter selection or outcome-selected folds; all five years reported

limitations: Historical CBR values are current vintage, not witnessed original releases; revisions may contaminate measured forecast errors.

Matching uses the published mean-cumulative period convention and working-day averaging illustrated by the CBR method; only full ordinary weeks are admitted. No claim to reconstruct unpublished daily forecasts or market consensus.
CBR can offset autonomous-liquidity errors with fine-tuning operations; an ex post accounting error need not contain delayed FX alpha.
SI daily execution, fees and margin remain research proxies; original executable quotes and broker fees are not proved.
Repeatedly opened development history cannot establish predictable earnings; positive Stage1 would still require independent prospective evidence.
forbidden_followups: retune sign, aggregation, week filter, TTL, control, leverage or costs after outcomes
promote the control or a selected good year
restart paper bootstrap or change collector schedules
